items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 82:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the source of the well? The Yesod of the Nukva is called a well, in the secret of the verse "the well which the princes dug, etc." And a source [Mabua] means: a spring, which is the Yesod of the male, which is the source of the ten Sefirot of the direct light, from which they are bestowed to the well of the Nukva. (Item 64).
